svg.title: Skills
svg.desc: Full Stack: React / Next.js 5/5, TypeScript 5/5, .NET / ASP.NET Core 4/5, Node.js / Express 4/5, Angular 3/5; Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure 4/5, AWS / GCP 4/5, Docker / Kubernetes 3/5, CI/CD · Terraform 3/5; AI / ML: TensorFlow / Keras 4/5, OpenCV / DeepFace 4/5, NLP / LLMs 4/5, Generative AI 4/5, MLOps pipelines 3/5; Data: SQL Server / Snowflake 5/5, PostgreSQL / Redis 4/5, MongoDB / Firebase 4/5, Neo4j 3/5; Testing & Tools: Playwright + Cucumber 4/5, Jest · Azure DevOps 4/5, Vitest · GitHub Actions 4/5; Languages: TypeScript · JavaScript 5/5, C# · Python · SQL 5/5, C++ · Java 4/5
